goal_coverage.applicability: Completeness and a cost bound for a supplied lattice; no general OneEnd solver until A(p) and output-to-endomorphism transport are independently priced. Required contribution: Exact enumeration cost and the separate unavailable curve-to-quaternion-lattice interface.

Completeness and a cost bound for a supplied lattice; no general OneEnd solver until A(p) and output-to-endomorphism transport are independently priced. Required contribution: Exact enumeration cost and the separate unavailable curve-to-quaternion-lattice interface.

Non-scalarity modulo a supplied torsion representation, not End(E) generation or saturation; scalar residue cannot certify scalarity. Required contribution: Cost of certifying useful non-scalar cycle maps before full interpolation.

An exact finite-chain accessibility statement or a conditional walk bound; no transfer from F_p-restricted p^1/4 to general F_p². Required contribution: Publicly computable drift toward a rare target, not target density.

An exact finite-chain accessibility statement or a conditional walk bound; no transfer from F_p-restricted p^1/4 to general F_p². Required contribution: Publicly computable drift toward a rare target, not target density.

Circuit-equivalence and resource comparison on a pinned DAG; no CSIDH security verdict and no comparison of disputants before three primary analyses are filed. Required contribution: Repeated independent affine inversions in the reversible action oracle.

A certified resource improvement for a specified action oracle; no new class-group structure algorithm or security estimate. Required contribution: Full-domain bounded exponent representatives and the reversible cost of finding them.

A source-defined accepted-law discrepancy or equality in a finite abstraction; no zero-knowledge theorem or recovery conclusion. Required contribution: Conditioning on eventual acceptance after secret-dependent retries.

A named missing-module-layer obstruction for a fixed template; no blanket SQIsign security or impossibility conclusion. Required contribution: Saturation of the public torsion module and common-map provenance.

A construction family or a scoped tangent-space obstruction; no rank claim beyond exhibited exact rational points. Required contribution: Preserving rational sections while changing fiber geometry, then producing rather than merely permitting a new section.

An exact squareclass enumeration certificate or a named unresolved quotient; no rank>=32 assertion from a Selmer upper bound. Required contribution: A complete L(S,2) basis without the unavailable full unit/class-group environment.

Independence of supplied points only; no discovery of a new curve and no promotion of the existing unpromoted closure candidate. Required contribution: Sound independence certification near numerical singularity.

NIST P-224: source-pin the 224-bit short-Weierstrass tuple and prime subgroup; treat absence of a supplied Montgomery model as an unresolved conversion question. This card audits the transfer/torsion-field interface only.
Ed448-Goldilocks: retain the cofactor-four Edwards torsion and distinguish subgroup and full-curve formulas. This card audits the transfer/torsion-field interface only.
brainpoolP384t1: use the t1 model and its actual isomorphism coefficients; do not substitute the r1 encoding or a different field. This card audits the transfer/torsion-field interface only.
Curve383187: source-pin the named 383-bit model and its cofactor before any torsion-domain statement. This card audits the transfer/torsion-field interface only.
Curve41417: retain Edwards exceptional/torsion strata under any proposed model conversion. This card audits the transfer/torsion-field interface only.
secp256k1: retain j=0 automorphisms in basis comparison, but do not infer an auxiliary torsion basis from its GLV map. This card audits the transfer/torsion-field interface only.
M-511: test the named Montgomery differential-state domain, including infinity and small-order inputs, at its own prime and subgroup. This card audits the transfer/torsion-field interface only.

Anomalous: explicit ell=p exception to etale rank-two Frobenius analysis; only source-certified additive-transfer control and separately scoped formula correctness. It is never grouped with ordinary prime-to-p subgroup security. This card audits the transfer/torsion-field interface only.
E-222: preserve its Edwards cofactor and identity/denominator cases rather than using a prime-order-only state space. This card audits the transfer/torsion-field interface only.
